oh, wanted to create similar request, so I will add my own ideas here: (copy pasted from other place)

no, this game is all about user created content, limiting users will only cause issues.

I could talk for hours about my ideas to "improve" performance, but I personally think that the best idea would be to get rid of the unity (not as a game engine, but from our - client point of view) - but this would be huge project for vrchat team. As allowing us to use unity to make avatar causes a lot of issues.

Imagine that vrchat team can now add super amazing replacment to dynamic bones, but it cost 200$ on unity store - no one will buy this. And people will keep using dynamic bones too, and they can't just remove that in 1 day.

But with own avatar editor they can just abstract that components, so you configure where your avatar have hair, skirt, other dynamic elements, and vrchat itself would use best available components at given time - and you don't need to buy any assets.

But like I said, it would be huge projects for few months of hard work - especially that they would need to support import of already existing avatars from unity, including all that advanced animators avatars with a lot of particle systems and other stuff like that.

With system like that they could really focus on improving performance of avatars without limiting users that much, it would be also much simpler to implement a lot of other optimizations, like LOD. Maybe even more advanced stuff like atlasing textures with same shaders etc (but that would be tricky for more advanced models)



Tho I think that rigging and modeling should not be part of editor itself, as recreating whole blender inside game would be too much :D But some simple common elements to allow create simple avatar from parts - why not.
This would also open possibility of creating in-game market of models or parts of it ;)
Oh my I still want this to be a thing.
Closing due to age, please make a new post if it is still relevant.

details:
Maybe in the long run we'll need to stop using the Unity Editor to upload Avatars and Worlds.

I feel that making the process of adjusting/creating and uploading a avatar should be made easier in many ways, for a better experience and all that, I understand that the problems and troubleshooting is already part of all of it and taking our time gets awarded in the end but making it all a bit more easy would be best imo.

-----

There could be a client/app for both Avatars and Worlds cause they have many different options/tools, or they may be all-in-one app.
It would have all the unity essentials we see on Unity Editor and everything that isn't needed wouldn't be there. VRChat approved shaders and tools would be displayed and ready to be used, also the ability to rig our avatar right from there would be good too, we just "draw" the arms, legs, fingers and adjust and just like Mixamo, it works pretty well but it needed further options so we can adjust it perfectly right from there and not need to do all of it on Blender although we can if we want to, rigging would include extra bones, other ones for stuff we want and so on. Decimating on Unity directly could also be a possibility. (like 'Mantis LOD Editor'). Live-Preview and walking/movement that we control just like ingame without needing to open the game and go into a world. Eye movement and mouth movement.

Opening the client/app for the first time it would give us a tutorial on how everything works and have links for the Docs/Wiki and so on, also a link for VRChat Discord in case of further help.

Limiting the usage of tools would be easier this way, and limiting other stuff too. It's easier and straight-forward if done correctly and takes off all the non-needed stuff from the Unity Editor.

Right now anyone can break worlds and avatars by accident or not by particle systems and other stuff, this could be more controlled with its own Unity Client/App thingy besides straight up Unity Editor.

This app/program/client could also be a Launch Option when opening the Game too.

----

Maybe I made this all sound a bit confusing, but to put it simple, an app/client to upload Avatars/Worlds outside of the Unity Editor. Apologies with the all over the place attempt to explain.
title: Own app/program to upload Avatars/Worlds (No Unity Editor)
